paragraphs: ArthaLedger began with a simple observation: most of us do not lack income as much as we lack clarity. Small everyday expenses add up quietly, and by the end of the month it is hard to say where the money went.
Our purpose is to give every household, student and small business in India a clear record of their money, as familiar as a traditional khata and as dependable as a modern app.
We build with care, read every piece of feedback, and improve ArthaLedger together with the people who use it. Thank you for trusting us with something so personal.

items.q: What exactly is ArthaLedger?
items.a: A money notebook on your phone. You create projects (like Personal or Business), add books inside them, and note down money you receive and spend. ArthaLedger keeps the totals, balances and summaries for you.

items.q: What is the difference between a project and a book?
items.a: A project is a folder for one part of your life, such as Family. A book is one account inside it, such as Groceries or Rent. Each book has its own balance, and the project shows them together.

items.q: Does it connect to my bank account or UPI?
items.a: No. ArthaLedger never asks for bank, card or UPI details and cannot move money. You type in what you want to keep track of.

items.q: Is it free?
items.a: Right now, yes. Early access is free for our first 50 users. Everyone else can also try every feature free until paid plans launch. Paid plans are coming soon, and we will tell you well before anything changes.

items.q: Is my data safe and private?
items.a: Yes. Your projects and books can only be opened by your own account, and they are encrypted while they travel and while they are stored. You can also lock any project or book with a PIN.

items.q: Do I need internet?
items.a: Not to add entries. ArthaLedger works offline and saves your changes as soon as you are connected again.

items.q: Can I use it on more than one phone?
items.a: Yes. Sign in with the same account on any phone or computer and your projects and books will be there.

items.q: How do I install it on Android?
items.a: ArthaLedger is not on the Play Store yet, so Android asks you to allow the install. Tap “Download for Android”, open the downloaded file, allow installs from your browser when Android asks, then tap Install. Prefer not to download? Open this website in Chrome and choose “Install app”, or simply use ArthaLedger in your browser.

items.q: Can I use it on an iPhone or iPad?
items.a: Yes. ArthaLedger is not on the App Store yet, but it works in Safari. Open this website in Safari, tap the Share button, then choose “Add to Home Screen”. ArthaLedger then opens from your home screen like any other app. To get reminders, open it from the home screen and allow notifications (this needs iOS 16.4 or later).

items.q: What are Groups?
items.a: A group collects related transactions from different books in one place, such as everything spent on a trip or a wedding. Select transactions in any book, tap Add to group, and see the total and a category breakdown. Your transactions stay in their books.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Go to Settings, then Delete account. Your account and all your projects and books are removed for good.

privacy.intro: Your money records are personal. This policy explains, in plain words, what ArthaLedger collects, how it is used and the control you have over it.

about.title: Who we are
blocks: ArthaLedger (“we”, “us”) is a personal money notebook for Android and the web, built and run by Javili Jashwanth in India. This policy explains what information the app uses, why, and the choices you have. It applies to the ArthaLedger app, website and services.

collect.title: Information we collect
blocks: We collect only what the app needs to work:
Account details: your name, email address, profile photo (if you sign in with Google) and how you sign in.
Profile details you choose to add, such as phone number, date of birth, gender and a short bio. These are optional.
Your records: projects, books, entries, categories, budgets, groups and settings that you create in the app.
Notification details: a device token for each phone or browser where you turn notifications on, your reminder times and time zone.
Feedback you send us: your message, its type and rating, and your name and email so we can reply.
Basic technical information needed to keep the service secure and working, such as sign-in times and error logs.
We do not collect your bank, card or UPI details, your contacts, your location or your messages.

use.title: How we use it
blocks: To run the app: show your books, keep balances and summaries, and sync your data across your devices.
To send the reminders and budget alerts you switch on.
To answer feedback and support requests, and to improve ArthaLedger.
To keep the service safe, prevent abuse and fix problems.
We do not use your records for advertising, and we do not build profiles about you.

share.title: When information is shared
blocks: We do not sell, rent or trade your information. We share it only in these cases:
Service providers that host and run ArthaLedger for us, mainly Google Firebase for secure storage, sign-in and notifications. They process data only on our instructions.
Testimonials: if you send praise and tick the box allowing it, we may show your message on our website with your first name only. You can ask us to remove it at any time.
When required by law, or to protect the rights and safety of our users and the service.

access.title: Who can see your data
blocks: Your books are protected by security rules so that only your signed-in account can read or change them. Groups you create are visible to you; shared amounts are entered by you.

For support and to keep the service running, the ArthaLedger team can see account information (name, email, sign-up and last sign-in dates) and simple usage counts such as how many books or entries an account has. The team does not view the contents of your entries, amounts or notes.

security.title: How we protect it
blocks: Data is encrypted while it travels (HTTPS) and while it is stored.
Passwords are handled by Google’s sign-in service and are never visible to us.
Optional PIN locks protect books and projects. PINs are stored only as salted hashes, never as the PIN itself.
No method of storage or transfer is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your information and will tell you if a breach affects you.

retention.title: How long we keep it
blocks: We keep your information for as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, your account and records are deleted straight away. Feedback messages are kept until they are no longer needed to support you or improve the app, or until you ask us to delete them.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
blocks: See and change your details at any time in Settings.
Download any book as a PDF or Excel file.
Turn reminders and alerts off in Settings, or block notifications in your phone settings.
Delete your account and all of your data (see below).
Ask us any question about your data, or to remove a testimonial, by writing to {email}.

deleteAccount.title: Deleting your account and data
blocks: In the app: open Settings, then Delete account, and confirm. Your account and all of your records are permanently deleted.

If you cannot sign in, email {email} from the address on your account with the subject “Delete my ArthaLedger account”. We will delete the account and all of its data within 30 days and confirm by email.

children.title: Children
blocks: ArthaLedger is not meant for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their information. If you believe a child has given us information, contact us and we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
blocks: If we change this policy, we will post the new version here with a new effective date. For important changes we may also let you know in the app or by email.

blocks: Questions, requests or concerns about privacy: {email}. We usually reply within a few days.

items.q: Is my financial data secure?
items.a: Yes. All your data is stored in Google Cloud Firestore, which is secured by Firebase security rules — only you can read or write your own data. Data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest by Google Cloud infrastructure.

items.q: How are passwords stored? Is my password safe?
items.a: ArthaLedger never stores your password. Authentication is handled entirely by Firebase Authentication (Google's identity platform), which stores only a salted, industry-standard hash (scrypt). Your password is never visible to us — not even in logs.

items.q: What is the hierarchy of data in ArthaLedger?
items.a: Your data is organized as: Account → Projects → Books (Cashbooks) → Entries. A Project can be "Family Expenses" or "Business". Each Project has multiple Books like "Monthly Budget". Each Book has individual transaction Entries.

items.q: Can I use ArthaLedger offline?
items.a: ArthaLedger is a Progressive Web App (PWA). The app shell loads offline, but adding or viewing entries requires an internet connection since data is stored in Firebase.

items.q: How do I install ArthaLedger on my phone?
items.a: On Android: open the app in Chrome, tap the three-dot menu, and select "Add to Home Screen". On iOS: open in Safari, tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".

items.q: What payment modes are supported?
items.a: Cash, UPI, Online (net banking / wallets), and Bank Transfer. You can record any transaction under any of these modes for accurate tracking.

items.q: Can I export my data?
items.a: Yes. Go to Settings → Export all data to download a complete JSON file of all your projects, books, and entries. You can also download PDF or spreadsheet reports from Settings → Download report.

items.q: How is the running balance calculated?
items.a: Each entry's "Balance After" is computed sequentially in chronological order. Income adds to the balance, expenses subtract. If you edit or delete a past entry, all subsequent balances are automatically recalculated.

items.q: Can multiple people use the same account?
items.a: Each account is tied to one email. However, you can use the "Entered By" field on each transaction to track who recorded it, making it suitable for shared family or business tracking.

items.q: What does "Artha" mean?
items.a: "Artha" is a Sanskrit word meaning wealth, purpose, and meaning. In ancient Indian philosophy, Artha is one of the four goals of life — the pursuit of material well-being with intention and wisdom.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Go to Settings → Delete account. This permanently removes your account and all of its data, so export your data first if you want to keep a copy.

items.q: Is ArthaLedger free?
items.a: Yes, ArthaLedger is completely free to use. There are no hidden charges, subscriptions, or premium tiers.
